comparison.objective: Replace and tighten a drone propeller while stabilizing it; candidate performs dry media separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Nut removal, keyed component replacement, and torque application versus screen manipulation and granular bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: New propeller correctly oriented and tightened, old one binned versus media recovered with washers retained and no loss.
comparison.reason: Mechanical replacement and tightening are unrelated to particle classification.
